title: The Kernel Reality Check: Benchmarking and Distilling Efficient Attention at Scale
abstract: arXiv:2611.22947v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Kernelized attention methods, which aim to replace the $O(N^2)$ complexity of softmax attention with $O(N)$ alternatives, have been the focus of intense research in the last five years. Despite growing interest, systematic evaluations and fair comparisons across approaches and scales are still missing. We analyze kernelized attention in two halves and highlight prominent limitations on each. On efficiency, FlashAttention achieves lower memory consumption and faster wall-clock time than SOTA kernelized methods during training and in vision transformers across most sequence lengths (with inference-time memory in causal language models the only clear exception), contradicting the core assumption for pure kernelized attention used as a drop-in replacement for softmax. We also discover that reported efficiency gains often fail to reproduce against modern baselines. On quality, current kernelized methods leave gaps of 2-10 points relative to s

translated_title: 核的现实检验：大规模高效注意力机制的基准测试与蒸馏
translated_abstract: 核化注意力方法旨在用 O(N) 复杂度的替代方案取代 softmax 注意力的 O(N²) 复杂度，在过去五年中一直是密集研究的焦点。尽管关注度日益增长，但目前仍缺乏针对不同方法和不同规模的系统性评估与公平比较。我们将核化注意力的分析分为两个部分，并指出各自存在的突出局限。在效率方面，在大多数序列长度下，FlashAttention 在训练阶段以及视觉 Transformer 中都比最先进的（SOTA）核化方法实现了更低的内存占用和更快的实际运行时间（唯一明显的例外是因果语言模型在推理阶段的内存占用），这与将纯核化注意力作为 softmax 即插即用替代方案的核心假设相矛盾。我们还发现，许多已报告的效率提升在与现代基线对比时往往无法复现。在质量方面，当前的核化方法与 softmax 相比仍存在 2-10 分的差距。
tldr: 该论文对核化注意力方法进行了大规模系统性基准测试，发现 FlashAttention 在效率上仍优于最先进的核化方法，且现有核化方法在质量上落后于 softmax 2-10 分，从而挑战了核化注意力作为 softmax 即插即用替代方案的核心假设。
en_tdlr: This paper benchmarks kernelized attention methods at scale, revealing that FlashAttention still outperforms state-of-the-art kernelized methods in efficiency while current kernelized methods lag softmax by 2-10 points in quality, challenging the core assumption of kernelized attention as a drop-in replacement for softmax.
